0022600172.text: The Miami Heat (2-4) are ninth in the East and fourth in the Southeast, one game back, and have won their last two games after going 2-4 over their last ten. The Los Angeles Lakers (4-2) sit first in the Pacific and are 7th in the West, having lost their most recent game. The Lakers will be without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after Miami lost 0-2 to Los Angeles in the 2025-26 season series, including a 134-126 loss in Miami on March 19.
